additional_info.subject: Reported issue translate
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The charging speed of the charging station is very slow. We think it's due to the charging station's load management. This has been happening since we connected the dispenser. I've attached photos showing the relevant charging processes. Here is the key to the graphs:
Orange: Power from the storage unit (discharging = negative)
Green: Actual power from the fast charger
Yellow: Released power from the fast charger
Since the dispenser was connected, we've always had <30kW of charging power, but our load management system releases more. Why is this? I can't imagine that only vehicles capable of charging less than 30kW drive to a fast charger. Thank you in advance.
Best regards,
Michael Hentzschel

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0420679-DC/Si-D/DE-[  MP / R3 170001694 ]  charging speed is very low CRM:02684000156
additional_info.body:
Hi,
yes we normally start the charging with a released power of 30kW. As soon as the charging starts, we increase the released power up to 46kW. In our eyes it seems like the charging station stays at the 30kW although we increased the released power while the charging process. Usual the released power is dynamic through the charging process.
The normal control for the relased power should be:
Charging station gets a released power of about 30kW.
Charging process starts
Storage activates
Increase released power
Storage discharges, increase released power further
The pictures attached show a charging process with the limited charging power of 30kW from yesterday (27.04.2025).
I also added a day before the charging cable modification (25.03.2025) with 4 charging processes with up to 130kW charging power. As you can see the current charging power never reaches the released power for the charging station. That’s why we assume the issue in the charging station.
In green the released power for the charging station is displayed, yellow is the current power input of the charging station.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Melanie Feser

additional_info.body:

While starting a charging session, the power limit from ELMS comes in at around 30 kW, and the session begins with the EVSE's maximum power set to 27 kW. However, after the session starts, ELMS dynamically increases its limit—it reached over 45 kW—but the EVSE’s maximum power remains fixed at 27 kW.
This issue started after the Dispenser installation.

additional_info.body:
Hallo Herr Berger,
weder ich noch meine Kollegen haben seit über einem Jahr etwas an der Regelung geändert. Bisher hat der Heartbeat Austausch funktioniert.
Heute Morgen hat der Ladevorgang und somit auch der Heartbeat-Austausch problemlos funktioniert?
Wir erhalten auf Status Word Bit 15 ein True. Im Control Word auf Bit 15
invertieren
wir dieses als FALSE zurück.
Also:
Status.15 = TRUE
à
Control.15 = FALSE
Ich habe diese Regelung nun geändert und wir spiegeln direkt Status Bit 15 auf Control Bit 15 zurück. OHNE INVERTIEREN. Nun scheint der Austausch wieder zu funktionieren.
Sie müssen aber etwas an der Auswertung geändert haben, sonst wäre dieser Bug ja schon viel früher aufgefallen?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
